scientific_integrity: Universal statements rely on the included algebraic proof; finite numerical linear-program comparisons are supplementary and cannot establish the theorem for all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted complete multipartite graphs with >=3 positive parts, unit graph-distance and rate-one-per-edge combinatorial Laplacian only; no claim for normalized generators, weighted edges, or W_p for p other than one. Historical priority may be affected by earlier Dobrushin-type formulas. The independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact all-time Wasserstein amplification and partition universality for multipartite graph heat flow
